client_faqs.question: Where is your shop or consultancy located and what are the timings?
client_faqs.answer: Anshu Computer & Tax Consultancy is located at Kaushal Market, Rath Road, Orai, Uttar Pradesh, India. Working hours: Monday to Saturday from 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM (Sunday Closed).

client_faqs.question: What are your service charges?
client_faqs.answer: Our service charges are highly affordable and depend on the specific work (ITR Filing, GST Registration, or PF Claim Resolution). For a quick transparent quote, call/WhatsApp us at +91 7217646673 or visit our consultancy in Kaushal Market, Orai.

client_faqs.question: What services do you offer?
client_faqs.answer: We specialize in: 1) PF Consultancy (PF Claim Settlement, UAN Consolidation, KYC Correction, Name/DOB Correction, Joint Declaration, Ex-Employer Cases), 2) Tax Services (Income Tax Return - ITR Filing, Tax Computation, Notice Assistance), 3) GST Services (New GST Registration, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B Monthly Filing), and 4) CSC Digital Services (Digital Citizen Services, Jeevan Pramaan, Pension & Govt Registrations).

client_faqs.question: What documents are required for PF Withdrawal or Correction?
client_faqs.answer: For PF claim settlement or KYC correction, please bring your Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Bank Passbook or Cancelled Cheque, UAN Number, and Aadhaar-registered Mobile Number.

client_faqs.question: What documents are required for ITR Filing?
client_faqs.answer: For Income Tax Return filing, please bring Form 16 (if salaried), Bank Statements for the financial year, Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and investment proof documents.

client_faqs.question: How can I book an appointment?
client_faqs.answer: You can visit our office in Kaushal Market, Rath Road, Orai between 11:00 AM and 6:00 PM (Mon-Sat), or reply with your preferred date and time between 11:00 AM and 6:00 PM to book a confirmed slot.
